activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1752 as Hume's representative Scottish Enlightenment activity year: he published Political Discourses and began work as librarian to the Faculty of Advocates in Edinburgh, giving him access to the collection used for his historical work.

sources.citation_text: The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy records Hume's Political Discourses in 1752 and his appointment that year as librarian to the Edinburgh Faculty of Advocates.
